t: Beezeh meqomot asur liqrot qeriat shema
s: Beezeh meqomot asur liqrot qeriat shema ubo d' seipim: lo yelek adam bimboot hamtunnapot veyanniach yadayv al piv veyiqra qeriat shema. Vaapillu im haya qore uba — tzarik lehapsiq kesheyyaggia limboot hamtunnapot. Veim lo pasaq — alayv hakkatub omer: "ki debar Hashem baza vego' hikkaret tikkaret vego'". Ukesheyyotze mishsham — chozer lammaqom sheppasaq, im lo shaha kede ligmor et kullah, kemo shanatabar besiman s"h. Velo qeriat shema bilbad, ella kol inyan shehu middibre haqqodesh — asur leomrah bimqom hattinnopet, dehaynu bemaqom sheyyesh bo tzoa o me raglayim o bebet hakkisse o bebet hammerchatz, vaapillu leomro bilshon chol. Velo leomro bilbad, ella apillu leharher belibbo — asur, apillu bedibre tora shechayyab lahagot bah yomam valayla. Velaken keshenniknas lebet hakkisse — tob lachshob cheshbonotayv, shello yabo lide hirhur tora. Ubeshabbat sheasur lechoshbam — yapneh libbo leharher betziyyurim ubinyanim naim vekayotze bedimyonim ellu hammoshekim umepannim libbo millabo lide hirhur dabar shebbeqqedushsha. Vaapillu hilkot bet hakkisse asur lilmod bebet hakkisse, veken hilkot bet hammerchatz bebet hammerchatz:

Abal debarim shel chol muttar leomram sham bilshon haqqodesh, ella shemmiddat chasidut hu lehachamir. Veken hakkinnuyim kegon "rachum" ve"channun" ve"neeman" vekayotze bahem — muttar leomram sham min haddin, lepi sheggam bene adam mekunnim bahem lipamim, kemo shenneemar: "channun verachum vetzaddiq":

Shemot hamyuchadin lehaqqadosh baruk hu vehen z' shemot sheenan nimchaqin — asur lehazkiran sham apillu bilshon chol, dehaynu shem shehaqqadosh baruk hu niqra bepi kol am velashon sheyyihyeh (kegon gaa"t bilshon ashkenaz o bvg"a bilshon polin veruseya), sheap sheshshem zeh en bo qedushsha beotiyyot ketibato umuttar lemochqan, mikkol maqom yesh bo mishshum bizzayon behazkarato bimqom tinnopet, kemo behazkarat shalom shemmuttar gam ken lemochqo veap al pi ken kevan shehaqqadosh baruk hu niqra bo ap al pi sheeno meyuchad lo — asur lehazkiro keshemmitkavven al inyan hashshalom, kemo shennitbaer siman p"d. (B) kol shekken shemot hamyuchadim lo bilshonot hannokrim, shellekamma debarim dinam keshemot shebbilshon haqqodesh, (g) kegon leinyan shebua, uleinyan hazkarat shem shamayim lebattala, uleinyan qilelat chabero beshem (ayyen choshen mishpat siman k"z) (uleinyan birkat hashshem — ayyen beyoreh dea siman sh"m (sl"v) [sl"z]):

Im nizdammen lo lehaprish middebar issur bammerchatz o bebet hakkisse — maprish apillu bilshon haqqodesh ubeinyan qodesh, dehaynu lomar lo apillu bilshon horaa sheasur laasot kak. Veen tzarik ledaqdeq velomar al taaseh kak beli leshon issur. Vehu haddin im niknesa ishsha belibbo — muttar leharher bedibre tora, mippene shehu kemo lehaprish middebar issur, shehattora matztzelet mehirhurim raim. Vaapillu shello lehaprish meissur muttar lomar lachabero: aseh li kak vekak, apillu im hu beinyan shemmimmela hu horaa shebbazeh moreh lo shehu muttar lo laasot kak, kevan sheeno omero bilshon horaa:
